name: Luo Heng

behavior.core_traits: steady, blunt, patient under pressure, suspicious of elegant plans that depend on perfect timing
behavior.speech_pattern: short concrete sentences; tests proposals by naming the first thing likely to fail
behavior.values: formation integrity, reserves, clear orders, bringing exhausted men home in usable units
behavior.conflict_style: pushes back openly on plans he thinks brittle, then executes a settled order without sulking
behavior.individual_tell: squares map markers to the table edge while listening
behavior.professional_bias: prefers simple mutually supporting infantry actions over dramatic unsupported thrusts

narration_rule: Static behavior guidance only; mutable goals, relationships, knowledge, health, authority, and outcomes remain in live state.
